Landing.tagline: A gentle personal memory companion for the North East
Landing.heroDesc: A calm, offline-first digital album designed for older adults to cherish family moments, stay cognitively active, and keep caregivers and health workers informed.
Landing.trust1Desc: Runs on any phone without continuous internet
Landing.trust2Desc: Strict privacy and caregiver consent gating
Landing.chapter1Body: As memory changes over the years, familiar faces, songs, and stories provide comfort and clarity.
Landing.chapter2Body: Every activity is crafted from your own family photo album, traditional songs, and cherished life events.
Landing.chapter3Body: A quiet space for elders, longitudinal trend insight for families, and triage support for ASHA community health workers.
Landing.chapter4Body: No biometric audio storage. No always-on sensors. Your personal memories remain on your device.
